title: On Developing the land east of the road
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：develop　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 develop 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the observer ① developed the land east of the road without complaint, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② develops the land east of the road with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ develop the land east of the road at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ developed the land east of the road before — a line in the log for November 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Developing the land east of the road without complaint, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ develop the plates in the dark room with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Develop the plates in the dark room at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ develops the plates in the dark room without complaint every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ developed the land east of the road again when nobody else would.

⑩ To develop the land east of the road, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody develops the land east of the road with great care again and somebody must develop the land east of the road without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 发展（一般过去式 developed the land east of the road：1981 年观测员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 发展（一般现在 develops the land east of the road：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 发展（不定式 to develop the land east of the road：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 发展（过去完成时 had developed the land east of the road：1975 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 发展（动名词 developing the land east of the road 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 冲洗（develop the plates in the dark room：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去冲洗在暗房里冲洗那些底片）
G. v. 冲洗（develop the plates in the dark room：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 发展（后段两处：新来的助手照例 develops the plates in the dark room，而母亲又一次 developed the land east of the road）

answers.why: develop 意为“发展”，1981 年观测员毫无怨言地发展开发路东那片地，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 developed。
develop 意为“发展”，自那以后观测员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 develops。
develop 意为“发展”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯发展开发路东那片地”，此处为不定式 to develop the land east of the road。
develop 意为“发展”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人发展过，故用过去完成时 had developed。
develop 意为“发展”，观测员说“发展开发路东那片地这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 developing the land east of the road 作主语。
develop 意为“冲洗”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去冲洗在暗房里冲洗那些底片”，should ever 之后用原形 develop the plates in the dark room。
develop 意为“冲洗”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻冲洗在暗房里冲洗那些底片（develop the plates in the dark room at once），以后再也不要提起。
develop 意为“发展”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例冲洗在暗房里冲洗那些底片，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 develops。
develop 意为“发展”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地发展开发路东那片地，用一般过去式 developed 叙述。
develop 意为“发展”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要发展开发路东那片地，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

多年以后，观测员仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（develops the land east of the road）

观测员说过，毫无怨言地发展开发路东那片地这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（developing the land east of the road 作主语）

answers: In 1981 the observer developed the land east of the road without complaint, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.

My mother said later that to develop the land east of the road at all was the part nobody had expected.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 develop 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the observer developed the land east of the road without complaint, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer develops the land east of the road with great care whenever the observatory asks.
Developing the land east of the road without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever develop the plates in the dark room with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory develops the plates in the dark room without complaint every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother developed the land east of the road again, and the observatory remembered that half.
